title: Unit Event — Our Happy Ending — Episode4 Our Last Show

meta.Event Outline: Following the successful 30th Anniversary Show, the Wonderlands×Showtime cast feel renewed determination for their respective dreams. Emu, realizing that the troupe will part ways sooner or later, attempts to put on a brave face and say goodbye with a smile. Meanwhile, Rui makes a bold proposition to the Otori brothers.

rows.Line: A few days later
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Convincing the other executives was arduous, to put it mildly...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: In any case, Wonderlands×Showtime has been cleared to become freelancers.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The discussion surrounding your troupe name did become a little heated, but we decided that you should be allowed to continue calling yourselves “Wonderlands×Showtime”...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Think of it as a small parting gift since we know this name means quite a lot to you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What did Emu say?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu said... She'll stay...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Understood...
Then, we'll start having contracts drafted up for the three of you...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'll get them to you as soon as we can. You'll also need to go over them with your parents before you sign.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Now, about the near future.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The soonest we'll be able to release you from your current contracts is next month.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: At the same time, the anniversary of Phoenix Wonderland's opening is coming up. Our plan is to put on a special show to mark the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, we'd like to ask if you'd stay with the park until then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For the park's anniversary...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Understood...
I'll discuss this with the others.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, please do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you both again for taking the time out of your busy schedules to meet with me.
Now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I said I'd ask the others...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it's a show to celebrate the park's anniversary. I'm sure they'll want to do it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And if so... This will become the last show we put on together as the cast of the Wonder Stage...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Then, we should make it the best one we've ever done...)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
A show to celebrate the park's anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I mean, we can't say no, can we?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: PXL's been really good to us, so we should return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I had a feeling that you'd all want to do this. I'll let them know, then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Once this show's over, you three are gonna start performing in other places with other people, right...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The four of you won't be doing shows together as much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, it's not like we'll be leaving the Wonder Stage for good. I anticipate we'll receive opportunities to perform there again from time to time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it is true that it will no longer be our top priority since we'll be performing in shows with other troupes and such.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may have to place them over the Wonder Stage if any scheduling conflicts arise.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We believe this is what we need to do to make our dreams come true...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What do I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They've been given the chance to grow and learn and really go after their dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But they seem really sad...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I can't leave things like this...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wanna make it so we can all be smiling when we say goodbye to each other...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's make our next show the most fun one we've ever done!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, for our last performance, we should put on that show...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That show...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The one we did with Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: One second. I have the script here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, here we are.
Hehe. It feels like we did this one such a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The Traveling Troupe”...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The one you all made for me.
That takes me back...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I still remember all my lines!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Once upon a time, there was an eccentric traveling theater troupe♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The troupe consists of a show-offy troupe leader, a clown who won't listen, and a songstress who can't sing in public!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The oddball group staged many shows, but they never managed to attract an audience!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then one day, as they were traveling through a forest, they encountered an alchemist who was performing a show all alone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: ...is how it starts, right♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Miku☆
You still remember it all♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because it was the very first show I did with Emu and everyone! I remember my lines for the cute fairy too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We should definitely do this one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because this is the super special show that let us become Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes.
I also have no objections.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then...
Starting tomorrow, we'll begin practicing it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh nooo...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I... I forgot where I put my script...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I remember practicing with it in my room, but I also brought it over here to practice and... Here?! There?! Thataway?! No, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Relax, I'm sure it'll...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh!
I remember seeing your script in that big box over there, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?
Oh, that's right...!
I left it there to make sure I wouldn't lose it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You forgot that you put it there?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's our Emu for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
They don't look sad anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway, bye, Miku! Bye, everyone!
We hope you're looking forward to an amazing show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... Okay, bye!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Rui, aren't you going back?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Yes...
See you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rui didn't seem all that happy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I noticed...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He must be feeling a little conflicted about doing that show, since it probably means the most to him. Also...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It even ends with...
“And they made shows together forever after.”
So...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for them...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I also wanna help them if I can...
But based on what they said, Emu's mind is already...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes...
This is quite the predicament...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, does that mean there's nothing we can...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, I don't believe so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're show performers, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That means there's always something we can do for them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, are you saying...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We should put on a show for them!
One that'll make them smile and cheer them up a bit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! That's a really great idea...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As the cast of this SEKAI, let's do what we can for them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So, what show are we gonna do?
Any ideas for that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, I have the perfect one in mind!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're going to do the same one as Emu and the others! “The Traveling Troupe”!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What?
But the way it ends... KAITO just said how...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, so...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't we make it into a happy ending that's perfect for them...?
